name: Kamishibai Slider
description: A paper theatre: pictures in a wooden frame with its doors folded back, each sheet drawn out sideways to reveal the next.

props.name: slides
props.type: { src: string; caption: string; alt?: string }[]
props.description: The sheets, in order. The caption is shown under the frame; alt describes the picture.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called when a button or arrow key moves to another sheet. Going forward draws the front sheet out to the right; going back slides the earlier sheet in over it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the slideshow. The frame is focusable; the left and right arrow keys, Home and End move through it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, up to 38rem wide. Also accepts every other prop of a section.
